# Doxycycline for Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (doxy PEP)

# Indications:

Men who have sex with men (MSM) and transgender women (TGW) with 1 or more

bacterial STI in the past 12 months OR MSM and TGW with multiple or anonymous

sex partners.

# Screening recommendations for DoxyPEP (obtain at baseline and q3 months):

-Gonorrhea and chlamydia at all anatomic sites of exposure

(urogenital, pharyngeal, and/or rectal)

-Syphilis antibody

-HIV Ag/Ab

# Order DoxyPEP #30 doses for 30 days with 2 refills:

[Doxycycline 200mg PO PRN within 24 hours but not later than 72 hours after](psozid-doxycycline-200mg-prn-doxy-pep)

condomless sex. Can be taken daily depending on sexual activity, but no

more than 200mg q 24 hours.

# Lab orders (see recommendations above):

[Lab: Syphilis antibody Serum](lrtz-syphilis-ab-w-reflex-to-rpr-w-titer)

[Lab: Chlamydia with Gonorrhea Urine](lrtz-chlamydia-with-gonorrhea-urine)

[Lab: Throat  swab for Chlamydia with Gonorrhea \(submit only ONE swab in media\)](lrtz-chlamydia-with-gonorrhea-throat)

[Lab: Rectal  swab for Chlamydia with Gonorrhea \(submit only ONE swab in media\)](lrtz-chlamydia-with-gonorrhea-rectal)

[Lab: Vaginal swab for Chlamydia with Gonorrhea \(submit only ONE swab in media\)](lrtz-chlamydia-with-gonorrhoeae-vaginal)

[Lab: HIV Ag/Ab](lrtz-hiv-ag-ab)

# **Please consider referral for HIV PrEP in all patients started on DoxyPEP**

[HIV Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis \(PrEP\) CONSULT](gmrctz-infectious-disease-prep)
